comment: The strategic-governance responsibilities address equity, sustainability and dependency risks. Patient safety, clinical effectiveness and accountable clinical authority are not named. As a result, the relationship between national architecture decisions and their consequences in care settings may remain unclear.

public.text: The strategic-governance responsibilities address equity, sustainability and dependency risks. Patient safety, clinical effectiveness and accountable clinical authority are not named. As a result, the relationship between national architecture decisions and their consequences in care settings may remain unclear.
public.suggestedRevision: Add responsibilities to: designate an accountable clinical-governance or patient-safety authority; define clinical-risk appetite and safety/outcome thresholds for DPI-H-enabled services; and require strategic approval of changes with material clinical or patient-safety consequences. Include patient safety and clinically significant service degradation among the systemic risks monitored.
